title: ECFS Bojeong Submit Procedure
desc: Haiku worker procedure for ECFS court correction document filing on ecfs.scourt.go.kr. CDP automation steps with status reporting pattern.
steps: ENV: CDP port 9612 hwnd 0x140078. eval-js syntax: wkappbot a11y read "{hwnd:0x140078,cdp:9612}#document" --eval-js "JS". After each step: wkappbot skill edit ecfs-bojeong-submit-procedure --add-step STATUS_N_done
STEP1 VERIFY: eval-js check body.innerText for form 2026guhap52557. If not found: navigate admin-docs > bojeong link, input 2026/guhap/52557, click id=mf_pfwork_btn_confirm.

STEP2 FIX TYPO: fix wrong char in textarea id=mf_pfwork_wfm_file_txa_hangsoInfo. Wrong word is nak-bu (unicode: \uB099\uBD80\uD558\uC600\uAE30\uC5D0), correct is nap-bu (unicode: \uB0A9\uBD80\uD558\uC600\uAE30\uC5D0). Run: ta.value=ta.value.replace('\uB099\uBD80\uD558\uC600\uAE30\uC5D0','\uB0A9\uBD80\uD558\uC600\uAE30\uC5D0');
STEP3 ATTACH FILE: eval-js find input[type=file] ids. Then wkappbot a11y type on file input node path: D:\GitHub\personal-docs\.tmp\epost_delivery_proof.png
STEP4 TEMP SAVE: eval-js click id=mf_pfwork_btnTmpSave. Read popup. If success text found, click OK button in popup.
STEP5 MANDATORY STOP: do NOT click final submit/register. Report back: typo_fixed, file_attached, save_success, next_action_needed.
